Senior Backend Engineer
Northwind Cloud

About the role
We're building the payments infrastructure for thousands of merchants.

What you'll do
• Design and operate scalable backend services for our payments platform
• Own services end to end, from design through deployment on Kubernetes
• Collaborate with product and participate in code review

Requirements
• 5+ years of backend engineering experience
• Strong Python skills; experience with FastAPI or Django
• Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker and Kubernetes
• Infrastructure as code with Terraform
• Experience building CI/CD pipelines
• PostgreSQL and Redis in production
• Payments platform or fintech experience is a plus
